item.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

item.title: Money operations require keyword-only idempotency_key
item.content: Every operation that moves money or mutates a payment/credit must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key`; check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key and return early without reapplying, and pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` entry. Introduced after double-refund incident INC-204.
